decisions.reason: The award-winning premium raisin Christmas stollen fits the firm's traditional seasonal strengths and repeated gold-medal recognition makes discontinuation unlikely.

This dark barley malt rye bread remained on its own page through 2024 and, as one of the few new breads still retained after other bread launches disappeared, it likely has a solid place in the core assortment.
The marzipan Christmas stollen closely matches the firm's established confectionery business and seasonal demand, so it is likely to stay unless assortment simplification becomes necessary.
